subject: Request: audit logs export options and retention evidence for SOC 2 review
messages:
From: Sandra Vega <svega@medicore.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Bright Audit Co. <audit@bright-audit.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: audit logs export options and retention evidence for SOC 2 review

Hi Dylan,

We are kicking off our SOC 2 evidence collection for MediCore Health and need details on the audit trail data Redwood can provide. Specifically can you confirm the following:

- Which event types are captured in the admin/audit logs (console actions, API calls, key management events, role changes, etc.)
- What the default retention windows are (hot/nearline/archive) and whether we can extend them at customer request
- Export formats available (JSON/CSV/parquet) and whether you can deliver scheduled exports to a customer S3 bucket or to our Splunk instance
- Are there options to redact PII from exported results, and do you provide a sample export or manifest we can attach to the SOC 2 workpaper?

Can you also share a short playbook on how we would request an export and an estimated lead time for an initial 7-day window?

Thanks,
Sandra
Sandra Vega
Compliance Lead, MediCore Health
+svega@medicore.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
To: Sandra Vega <svega@medicore.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit logs export options and retention evidence for SOC 2 review

Hi Sandra,

Thanks for the detailed list — happy to provide everything you need. Summary below; I attached a schema and a short export playbook for reference.

What we log (high level):
- Admin activity: console sign-ins (user ID, timestamp, IP), role/permission changes, MFA events, session terminations.
- API-level metadata: request timestamps, endpoint, response status, request ID, client_id (we do not log prompt text or user content in the admin logs).
- Key management hooks: KMS key usage events (encrypt/decrypt), key rotation actions.
- System and infra events: node reboots, agent restarts, autoscaler decisions and capacity moves (host-level).
- Model-serving telemetry: per-request token metadata (latency, model variant, token counts) but not customer prompt content.
- Admin configuration changes: routing policy edits, rollout actions, quota/grant changes.

Retention model:
- Default: 90 days hot (searchable), 365 days cold archive (retained for regulatory checks).
- Archive extension: we can configure a customer-specific S3 archival policy for multi-year retention; we support custom retention buckets or extended retention on request (subject to contract).

Export options and formats:
- Daily snapshot exports (JSON or CSV) pushed to an S3 destination you control (preferred for long-term retention).
- Near-real-time forwarding to Splunk via HEC or to a customer-managed Kafka endpoint for ingestion.
- Batch exports delivered as gzipped JSONL or parquet for large windows.
- We provide a manifest (export_manifest_YYYYMMDD.json) with SHA256 checksums for each file.

Redaction & PII controls:
- We can redact or pseudonymize user identifiers on exported datasets. Laura (cc'd) can confirm a mandatory redaction checklist we run before export.
- Sensitive fields (user-entered content) are excluded from admin logs; any fields that could contain PII are subject to redaction per the attached guidelines.

Attachments included: audit-log-schema_v2.csv (column-level schema) and export-playbook_s3-splunk.md (step-by-step request/playbook).

Operational notes / next steps:
1) Confirm target delivery method (S3 bucket ARN + principal OR Splunk HEC endpoint + token).
2) Tell us the time window (you asked 7 days — we can produce a sample export within 48 hours once access is authorized).
3) We will run the pre-export redaction checklist and produce a manifest + checksum.

If you'd like, we can also arrange a short call with our SRE team to walk through the Splunk HEC setup.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Sandra Vega <svega@medicore.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit logs export options and retention evidence for SOC 2 review

Dylan — thanks for the clear summary. A few security items to include before we proceed with delivery: 

- Ensure user identifiers in exported artifacts are pseudonymized (salted HMAC) when requested by customers; store salt in customer-managed KMS where possible.
- Confirm KMS usage events are included in the export (logs show key IDs and encrypt/decrypt actions).
- Apply the redaction_guidelines.pdf to strip any free-text fields that could contain PII or PHI; produce both a redacted and a metadata-only export if the customer requests.
- For Splunk ingestion, enforce token-scoped indexes and a short TTL for any ingestion tokens we hand over; recommend HEC tokens restricted to the target index.

Operational ask: Priyom — please estimate the ETA to produce a 7-day sample export with the redaction checklist applied and a manifest (sha256). Also confirm the Splunk HEC token creation steps and whether we can auto-rotate the token after delivery.

I'll review the sample once ready and sign off for delivery to MediCore.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
From: Sandra Vega <svega@medicore.com>

Dylan — thanks, that all looks good.

We'd like:
- Primary delivery: S3 bucket (ARN: arn:aws:s3:::medicore-soc2-uploads) — we will provide an IAM principal for upload.
- Secondary: Splunk HEC ingestion for near-real-time monitoring; we'll provide the HEC endpoint and ask you to generate a scoped token.
- Please produce the 7-day sample export (2026-11-20 to 2026-11-26) with the redacted version and the manifest.

ETA target: are you able to deliver the sample by 2026-12-02? We can escalate if you need a shorter window.

Once we have the sample and manifest we'll attach it to our SOC 2 workpaper.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Sandra
